scope: Real shared authoring access, containing compile scope, placed-space/place adapters, retained controller authority, protected standalone refresh, atomic acceptance/history and canonical project IO. This is not whole task11 or UI acceptance.
outcome: Five complementary integration cases pass. No product defect reproduced and no product logic repair made. Three initial new-test failures were corrected as invalid fixture placement and incidental event ordering, with the original failed execution retained. All 39 selected existing seam cases passed once against the identical product source.

cases.name: accepts one nested transaction when shared space and place adapters move delete and add actual members
cases.proof: Actual village -> inn -> room -> hearth resolves to the independently known village root. Shared space member move, shared place room move, exact room-subtree deletion and explicit new room addition chain through issued previews and retainAuthoringPreview. Deleted descendants stay absent; surviving peer and source library remain exact. Final shared Apply, one Undo, one Redo and both canonical serialization forms preserve the full project.

cases.name: preserves the continuing build when an obsolete member adapter hands off after a newer shared edit
cases.proof: A real manual build is followed by an external placed-member deletion preview. A newer shared edit makes that exact same-controller handle session-obsolete. Retention rejects with stale/authoring-session-lineage while preserving active project identity, build disclosure, selection and history. The valid current generation then removes and adds a member, retains its allocated root and newer edit, re-previews and applies once with exact IO/history and placed-space selection.

cases.name: retains opaque transfer identities when an ordinary shared containing edit moves their actual destination
cases.proof: Real persisted opaque transfer pairs survive an ordinary previewPlacedPlaceEdit move through the known actual root, without explicit connection editing. Logical connections and pair IDs remain exact; all four interpreter traversal routes exist and target the new concrete port landing, not the old landing. Shared acceptance/history and both canonical IO forms are exact.

cases.name: uses the retained protected checkpoint when shared edits refresh a standalone graphic twice before acceptance
cases.proof: Two real graphic refreshes with different source cells are connected by retainAuthoringPreview and editAuthoringDraft. The second uses the retained protected raster rather than the live baseline. Selected frozen ports, sibling occurrence, every event keyed by actual ID, unmanaged cells/stacks and full transaction/IO state remain exact.

cases.name: rejects editable raster adoption when a shared continuation follows a retained graphic refresh
cases.proof: A legitimate retained graphic checkpoint does not authorize an arbitrary later raw draft pixel. The next real refresh rejects with ownership and preserves the active editable draft, original issued frozen pixels, live project and empty history.
